name: Harley-Davidson V-Rod
engine: 1130 or 1250 cc liquid-cooled Revolution DOHC V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Harley's liquid-cooled muscle cruiser. Cooling leaks, cam chain tensioners and the under-seat tank are things to check.

G: The fuel tank sits under the seat. Check it for rust if the bike was stored.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Tensioner and cooling
known.what: Cam chain tensioner wear and radiator leaks are the most reported problems.
